title: Fill in the blanks (H5P.Blanks)
description: Sentences with blanks. Write each blank as {1}, {2}, … in the sentence and list its answer in the same order. Every answer must appear in the cited source text.

instruction.description: One sentence telling the learner what to do

text.description: A sentence from the lesson with placeholders {1}, {2}, … where the blanks are

answer.description: The correct word or short phrase, without * / :

alternatives.description: Other accepted spellings or synonyms found in the source; may be empty

tip.description: A hint that does not give the answer away; empty for none
